nodes.description: Address of TokenTransferProxy contract stored in AugustusStorage; set at construction and used to pull user tokens.
payable address receiving protocol fees; mutable only by admin via setFeeWallet.
Mapping address => FeeStructure holding partner share, flags, feePercent and data.
Mapping bytes4 selector => router implementation address used by the fallback delegatecall dispatch.
AccessControl mapping bytes32 => RoleData (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, WHITELISTED_ROLE, ROUTER_ROLE) governing admin-gated functions.
AugustusSwapper constructor: deploys TokenTransferProxy, sets feeWallet and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender.
Payable fallback dispatching msg.data to the router implementation resolved from selectorVsRouter via delegatecall.
onlyAdmin function that delegatecalls IAdapter.initialize on a WHITELISTED_ROLE adapter.
onlyAdmin function that delegatecalls IRouter.initialize on a ROUTER_ROLE router.
onlyAdmin function binding a selector to a router address that must hold ROUTER_ROLE.
onlyAdmin function creating a FeeStructure entry for a partner with validated share and fee percent.
onlyAdmin rescue function sending ETH (gas-limited call) or ERC20 tokens out of the swapper.
TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom: onlyOwner token pull that requires from == tx.origin or a contract address.
Utils.transferTokens: sends ETH via call with fixed 10000 gas or ERC20 via safeTransfer.
Address.sendValue: forwards wei to a payable recipient using a low-level call after a balance check.
msg.sender: caller identity used for role checks, onlyOwner and onlyAdmin gating.
tx.origin: used in TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom to whitelist the token source address.
delegatecall to router implementation inside fallback, executing arbitrary router code in swapper storage context.
delegatecall used by initializeAdapter and initializeRouter to run adapter/router init code in swapper context.
Low-level call with value transferring ETH (gas-limited 10000 in Utils/transferTokens, unlimited in Address.sendValue).
ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling tokens from the user address inside TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
bytes4 selector argument of setImplementation identifying the routed function.
address implementation argument of setImplementation that is stored in selectorVsRouter.
address adapter argument of initializeAdapter, required to hold WHITELISTED_ROLE.
calldata data argument passed into adapter/router initialize delegatecalls.
local variable in fallback holding selectorVsRouter[selector], the delegatecall target.
token address argument of TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
from address argument of TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom, checked against tx.origin or isContract.
to recipient address argument of TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
amount argument of TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom forwarded to safeTransferFrom.
storage pointer to registeredPartners[partner] written in registerPartner.

edges.reason: fallback reads selectorVsRouter to resolve the delegatecall target for an arbitrary selector.
fallback delegatecalls the resolved implementation with raw msg.data, handing control to external code.
selector parameter indexes into selectorVsRouter in setImplementation.
implementation parameter is written into selectorVsRouter, controlling future fallback dispatch.
setImplementation requires the implementation to hold ROUTER_ROLE via hasRole.
onlyAdmin checks hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) before state change.
adapter parameter is the delegatecall target and must be whitelisted.
initializeAdapter delegatecalls adapter.initialize, running untrusted adapter code in swapper context.
router initialize data supplied by admin is forwarded in the delegatecall payload.
initializeRouter delegatecalls router.initialize, executing external router code in storage context.
onlyAdmin gate on initializeAdapter binds msg.sender to the admin role.
registerPartner writes partner share, flags and fee percent into registeredPartners.
local FeeStructure pointer aliases the registeredPartners mapping slot being updated.
transferTokens rescue path is restricted to admin accounts via onlyAdmin.
transferTokens forwards ETH using a low-level value call to an admin-supplied destination.
Utils.transferTokens performs a gas-capped value call when the token is ETH_ADDRESS.
Address.sendValue performs a full-gas low-level value call to a payable recipient.
transferFrom compares the from argument with tx.origin, making authorization origin-based.
tx.origin determines whether the token pull is allowed in TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
from parameter is validated against tx.origin or isContract before the transfer.
token parameter selects the ERC20 contract invoked by safeTransferFrom.
to parameter is the recipient of the safeTransferFrom call.
amount parameter flows into safeTransferFrom for the token pull.
transferFrom performs the ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling tokens from the user.
onlyOwner on TransferProxy uses _msgSender()/msg.sender to gate the token pull.
constructor deploys TokenTransferProxy and stores it in tokenTransferProxy.
constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender, seeding the whole privilege graph.
feeWallet is set by admin only, constraining where rescued value can be routed.
local implementation from selectorVsRouter becomes the delegatecall target in fallback.
calldata data argument of initializeRouter is encoded into the delegatecall payload.
registerPartner is admin gated through the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE membership in _roles.

normalization_plan.reason: selector is only consumed as the mapping key in setImplementation and has no independent semantics.
implementation is written straight into selectorVsRouter by setImplementation.
adapter is the whitelisted delegatecall target used solely by initializeAdapter.
data is only forwarded into the router initialize delegatecall payload.
the fallback local is the resolved address that is immediately delegatecalled.
token parameter exists only to select the ERC20 contract used by transferFrom.
from is the origin-checked source address of the transferFrom token pull.
to is the recipient argument of the transferFrom token pull.
amount is passed directly to safeTransferFrom inside transferFrom.
